Netanyahu calls Gaza genocide claims 'biggest lie' at UNGA

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, speaking at the UN General Assembly (UNGA), rejected accusations of genocide in Gaza, calling them the 'biggest lie of the century'. He also criticized those making the claims. The UNGA session's agenda was dominated by discussions on Gaza, with speeches from Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas and Netanyahu.
